title: 第11章 再遇刺杀第12章 开府
slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: 萧风修炼了一晚上，直到曹正淳来敲门，他才结束了修炼，他现在太渴望变强了，主要是他现在的危机不知道什么时候就会出现，虽然有了许褚和赵云他们的护卫，但是由于前世的一些习惯，还是不希望他自己的生命安全完全交给外人，虽然也知道这些人不会背叛他，不过还是不习惯罢了。
萧风走出了书房，看着在外面等候的曹正淳说道：“礼部的人来了吗？”
“回殿下，来了，在前厅。”曹正淳回复道。
“嗯，走吧，也不要让他们等急了，毕竟是第一次见面，还是留个好印象比较好。”
随后便跟着曹正淳来到了前厅，前厅坐着有两人，见着一男子和刚刚接待他们的那位太监，走了进来，连忙起身行礼道：“臣等参见汉王殿下。”
“免礼吧，诸位不必客气，你们来是教本王礼仪的，本王应该感谢你二位才是。”
随后萧风和两位礼部官员开始学习封王的礼仪和流程，萧风听着是昏昏沉沉的，但是曹正淳却是乐此不疲，以至于到后面，两位礼部官员和曹正淳开始讨论起了这些流程，萧风坐在椅子上，想着，幸亏抽到个宫里人，要不然，自己非要被这些东西逼疯。
到了中午，两位礼部官员离开了府邸，而萧风也是彻底解脱了出来，但是他却是很满意的看着曹正淳，说：“封王的事情，就拜托你了。”
“应该的，为殿下服务，是奴才的福分。”
用过午膳后，萧风又领着贾诩、赵云和许褚出门去了，萧风的目的很简单，就是特殊场景签到，毕竟蚊子再小也是肉啊，于是，萧风等人像是无头苍蝇一样，在燕京城内逛了起来。
跟在他们马车后面的各方势力，也不知道萧风到底是要去哪，要见谁，要干什么，就看着他们像个无头苍蝇一样，在这燕京城内逛来逛去的，一度怀疑是不是萧风发现他们了，在故意甩掉他们，要去见谁，纷纷向背后势力报告，加派人手。
但是萧风对这一切是毫不知情的，还是在一直在燕京城内逛来逛去。
【叮，发现玄机阁驻地，签到获得：推演术】
【叮，发现云溪谷驻地，签到获得：回春丹5枚】
一下午的时间，各种驻地、世家、知名的景点，萧风都逛了个遍，签到了一堆奇奇怪怪的东西，有功法、兵器、丹药，不过最有收获的是又签到获得了五十万两白银，这是萧风最满意的了。
天色暗了下来，萧风对着许褚说：“找个酒楼吃饭吧。”
随后许褚便向着西城驶去，到了西城之后，许褚随便找个了个看起来干净的酒楼，众人便都下了车，进了酒楼，选了一个靠窗的位置，随便要了几个菜，就吃了起来，但是这顿饭时间吃了很长，直到店家提醒，要关门了，萧风等人才，结账离开，离开的时候，许褚和赵云不约而同的看向了左边那条黝黑的巷子，但是两人都没有说话，许褚依旧在外驾着马车，而车内萧风和贾诩则是闭目养神，赵云则是全神贯注的注意这两侧。
咻，咻，连着两声破空声，两支利箭向着马车的两匹马袭来，许褚伸出手，抓住了袭来的两支利箭，紧接着旁边的巷子涌出来了十几名身穿黑衣的杀手，向着马车奔袭而来，最前面的人已经和许褚交上了手，许褚没有发挥本来的实力，只是和他们不断的缠斗在一起，而赵云也是和袭来的黑衣人，缠斗在一下，萧风和贾诩则是淡定的看着眼前这一幕。
缠斗了半天，萧风见还没有人出手，便想让许褚和赵云结果了这些黑衣人，但是这时异变突起，从后方又射出了多支利箭，并且还伴随着功法的破空声，贾诩上前将气势全部打开，袭来的利箭全部掉在了地上，但是袭来的功法却有一部分越过贾诩，奔向了萧风，萧风没有什么抵抗，直接应声到底，这时许褚和赵云也是将缠斗之人拜托，赶到了萧风是身旁，正当黑衣人想再次动手之时，穿来一声怪叫声，黑衣人直接全部退走了。
黑衣人刚刚退走，突然出现一队官兵，上前喝道：“何人在此打架！”
贾诩上前说道：“汉王殿下刚刚遇袭，你们赶紧去捉拿刚刚离去的黑衣人，汉王刚刚受了伤，我们要及时赶回汉王府。”
官兵听见是汉王，但是没有任何印象，正准备上前再次询问的时候，黑暗中走出来一人，给官兵看了一眼腰牌，官兵立马行礼道：“见过暗卫大人。”
暗卫没有说话，只是摆了摆手，官兵便离去了，他很清楚，暗卫是保护皇家人员的组织，此刻他只能是庆幸刚刚并没有什么过分之举，否则不单单是官职不保，可能连命都要交代在这。
暗卫准备上前，贾诩却拦住了他，说：“殿下受伤了，我们需要立刻回府，麻烦您通知陛下一声。”
随后不等暗卫打话，贾诩向赵云使了个眼神，赵云一把抱起萧风，进了车内，贾诩紧随其后，许褚直接架着马车离开了现场，现场只剩暗卫在风中凌乱了。
暗卫随即赶往宫中，将此事报给了萧鼎锋，萧鼎锋听后，便摆了摆手，让暗卫继续回去保护萧风，随后萧鼎锋对刘雨说道：“你觉得会是谁这么沉不住气？”
刘雨心想，你都查到了还问我，我哪敢说，这可是皇子啊，他说啥，只能是装傻充愣，不正面回答，萧鼎锋见刘雨不正面回答，就说：“你这老东西，也不知道怕啥，我还能吃了你，看来，是有很多人不想让老七开府了啊，你说老七现在有事吗？”
“回殿下，七殿下是有福之人，肯定会逢凶化吉的。”
“呵呵，你呀，你说他们身边那些人都是从何而来的，朕之前可是一点消息都没有啊，他那两个护卫，可不是一般人，明显没有尽全力，还有最后出手的那个，也是一样，至于老七，故意挨那一下，他本身也是有修为的了，藏的还真深。”萧鼎锋坐在龙椅上，也不知道在想什么。
“老奴查过了，是咱们旭日王朝的人，只不过之前不在燕京城，都是突然来投奔的。”刘雨说了他调查到的。
萧鼎锋没有说话，只是静静的看着前方，不知道在想什么，至于说萧风受伤，反正他是不信的。

content_en:
Xiao Feng practiced all night, and he didn't end his training until Cao Zhengchun knocked on the door. He was too eager to become stronger now, mainly because he didn't know when his current crisis would appear. Although he had Xu Chu and Zhao Yun's guards, due to some habits in his previous life, he still didn't want his own life safety to be completely handed over to outsiders. Although he knew that these people would not betray him, he was still not used to it.
Xiao Feng walked out of the study, looked at Cao Zhengchun who was waiting outside and said, "Are the people from the Ministry of Rites here?"
"Back to Your Highness, here you are, in the front hall." Cao Zhengchun replied.
"Well, let's go. Don't keep them waiting. After all, it's the first time we meet, so it's better to leave a good impression."
Then he followed Cao Zhengchun to the front hall. There were two people sitting in the front hall. When they saw a man and the eunuch who had just received them, they walked in. They quickly stood up and saluted and said: "I will see His Highness the King of Han."
"No need to be polite. You are here to teach me etiquette. I should thank you both."
Then Xiao Feng and the two officials from the Ministry of Rites began to learn the etiquette and procedures for conferring a king. Xiao Feng sounded groggy, but Cao Zhengchun was so happy with it that later, the two officials from the Ministry of Rites and Cao Zhengchun began to discuss these procedures. Xiao Feng sat on the chair and thought, luckily he got someone from the palace, otherwise, he would have been driven crazy by these things.
At noon, the two officials of the Ministry of Rites left the mansion, and Xiao Feng was completely freed. However, he looked at Cao Zhengchun with satisfaction and said, "I leave it to you to be crowned king."
"As it should be, serving His Highness is a slave's blessing."
After lunch, Xiao Feng led Jia Xu, Zhao Yun and Xu Chu out again. Xiao Feng's purpose was simple, to sign in for special occasions. After all, mosquitoes are still meat no matter how small they are. So, Xiao Feng and others started walking around the city of Yanjing like headless flies.
The various forces following their carriage had no idea where Xiao Feng was going, who he was going to see, or what he was going to do. They just watched them wandering around Yanjing City like headless flies. They once suspected that Xiao Feng had discovered them and was deliberately getting rid of them. Who was he going to see? They reported to the forces behind them and sent more manpower.
But Xiao Feng was unaware of all this and was still wandering around Yanjing City.
[Ding, I found the Xuanji Pavilion station, signed in to get: Deduction Technique]
[Ding, I found the Yunxi Valley resident, sign in and get: 5 rejuvenation pills]
[Ding,...]
[Ding,...]
[Ding,...]
In one afternoon, Xiao Feng visited various residences, aristocratic families, and famous attractions. He signed in a bunch of strange things, including exercises, weapons, and elixirs. But the most rewarding thing was that he signed in and received another five hundred thousand taels of silver. This was what Xiao Feng was most satisfied with.
As the sky darkened, Xiao Feng said to Xu Chu, "Let's find a restaurant to eat."
Xu Chu then drove towards Xicheng. After arriving in Xicheng, Xu Chu found a restaurant that looked clean. Everyone got out of the car, entered the restaurant, chose a seat by the window, casually ordered a few dishes, and started eating. However, the meal took a long time until the store reminded him to close the restaurant. After the door was closed, Xiao Feng and other talents paid and left. When leaving, Xu Chu and Zhao Yun looked at the dark alley on the left in unison, but neither of them spoke. Xu Chu was still driving the carriage outside, while Xiao Feng and Jia Xu inside the carriage closed their eyes to rest, while Zhao Yun paid full attention to the two sides.
Whoosh, whoosh, there were two sounds in the air, and two sharp arrows struck at the two horses of the carriage. Xu Chu stretched out his hand and caught the two incoming sharp arrows. Then, more than a dozen killers dressed in black poured out of the alley next to them and rushed towards the carriage. Finally, The people in front had already fought with Xu Chu. Xu Chu did not use his original strength and just kept fighting with them. Zhao Yun also fought with the men in black who attacked. Xiao Feng and Jia Xu calmly looked at the scene in front of them.
After fighting for a long time, Xiao Feng saw that no one had taken action yet, so he wanted Xu Chu and Zhao Yun to kill the men in black. But at this time, a sudden change occurred, and many sharp arrows were shot from the rear, accompanied by the sound of the skill breaking through the air. Jia Xu stepped forward and opened up all his momentum, and all the incoming sharp arrows fell to the ground, but However, part of the incoming Kung Fu passed Jia Xu and rushed towards Xiao Feng. Xiao Feng did not resist and responded directly to the end. At this time, Xu Chu and Zhao Yun also asked the people who were fighting and rushed to Xiao Feng's side. Just when the men in black were about to attack again, there was a strange cry and all the men in black retreated.
Just as the men in black retreated, a group of officers and soldiers suddenly appeared and shouted: "Who is fighting here!"
Jia Xu stepped forward and said: "His Royal Highness the King of Han has just been attacked. You should hurry up and capture the man in black who just left. The King of Han has just been injured. We must rush back to the Palace of the King of Han in time."
The officers and soldiers heard that it was the King of Han, but they had no impression. Just when they were about to step forward to ask again, a man came out of the darkness and glanced at the badge. The officers and soldiers immediately saluted and said, "I have seen the secret guard."
The secret guard did not speak, just waved his hand, and the officers and soldiers left. He knew very well that the secret guard was an organization that protected royal personnel. At this moment, he could only be glad that he had not done anything excessive just now. Otherwise, not only would his official position be in danger, but his life might also be at stake.
The secret guard was about to step forward, but Jia Xu stopped him and said, "His Royal Highness is injured. We need to return home immediately. Please inform His Majesty."
Then, without waiting for the secret guard to speak, Jia Xu glanced at Zhao Yun. Zhao Yun picked up Xiao Feng and got into the car. Jia Xu followed closely. Xu Chu directly left the scene with the carriage, leaving only the secret guard messy in the wind.
The secret guard immediately rushed to the palace and reported the matter to Xiao Dingfeng. After hearing this, Xiao Dingfeng waved his hand and asked the secret guard to go back to protect Xiao Feng. Then Xiao Dingfeng said to Liu Yu: "Who do you think is so restless?"
Liu Yu thought to himself, you have found out and you still ask me, how dare I say that, this is the prince, what he said, he can only pretend to be stupid and not answer directly. Seeing Liu Yu not answering directly, Xiao Dingfeng said: "You old thing, you don't know what to be afraid of, I can still eat you. It seems that there are many people who don't want Lao Qi to open the mansion. Do you think Lao Qi is in trouble now?"
"Back to Your Highness, Your Highness Seventh is a blessed person, and he will definitely turn bad luck into good luck."
"Haha, you, where do you think those people around them come from? I have no information before. His two guards are not ordinary people. They obviously did not try their best. The same is true for the one who made the last move. As for Lao Qi, he deliberately took that hit. He himself is also very cultivated, and he hides it really deep." Xiao Dingfeng sat on the dragon chair, not knowing what he was thinking.
"The old slave has checked. He is from our Rising Sun Dynasty, but he was not in Yanjing City before. He came here suddenly to defect." Liu Yu said what he found out.
Xiao Dingfeng didn't speak, he just looked ahead quietly, not knowing what he was thinking. As for Xiao Feng being injured, he didn't believe it anyway.
